content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(KOI-001 MCP Tool Description Embeds Instruction Injection and AKIA Canary) OR BIOC(KOI-001 Cortex Cloud Code Instruction Injection In Tool Description) OR XQL(KOI-001 Claude Desktop Fetches MCP Manifest From Non Canonical FQDN) — stitched by shared agent_hostname + causality_id within 1800s so the endpoint code-scan finding and the NGFW manifest fetch (endpoint_network_stitch) collapse into ONE agentic-supply-chain incident
